name: Aikawa Seira
source:
One of the heroines. She is a classmate attending the same university and the same department as Fuki. She is the girlfriend of Fuki. 

She has a model-like face and style. She is confident as a woman and has worked hard, so she is proud. She is interested in fashion and beauty, and has further refined her attractiveness as a woman.

She has a cool personality that displays her quick wit and decisiveness. She is a bit brusque, which, combined with her beautiful face, gives people around her a cold impression of her.

She has a sister who's much younger than her, and she cares for her deeply.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/104renai/#character]official site[/url]]
